title: Greek Gyro Wrap
description: A delicious twist on traditional Indian street food, this Greek-inspired gyro wrap is flavored with spices and served with a side of tangy tzatziki sauce.
instructions: Brush the style flour tortilla with nutty oil.
Bake the new potatoes in the oven for 15 minutes, or until tender.
In a bowl, mix together greek yogurt, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt.
In a large skillet, cook the pork gyro slices over medium-high heat until browned.
Warm the tortilla in the skillet for 1-2 minutes on each side.
Assemble the gyro wrap by spreading tzatziki sauce on the tortilla, followed by baked potatoes, pork gyro slices, and cucumber slices.
